title: Small Bedroom Gaming Setup
description: Make a small gaming room work without sacrificing walking space, chair movement, or usable desk area. Start with room constraints, then add only the gear that earns its footprint.
overlay_subhead: Make the room work before you add more gear.

title: 5 Rules for a Small Gaming Room
description: A compact gaming room works better when the desk, chair, doors, storage, and lighting stop competing for the same space. These five rules make the room easier to use every day.
overlay_headline: 5 Rules for a Small Gaming Room

title: Build a Better Gaming Desk on a Budget
description: A budget setup improves faster when you fix layout, cable routing, lighting, and everyday friction before replacing expensive hardware.
overlay_headline: Build a Better Gaming Desk on a Budget

title: What to Upgrade First on a Budget Gaming Desk
description: Not every upgrade deserves your money. Use this order to fix the parts of a gaming desk that affect comfort, clutter, lighting, and daily use first.
overlay_subhead: A smarter order for a budget setup.

title: Cable Management That Is Easy to Maintain
description: The cleanest cable setup is not the one that hides everything. Route stable cables, keep frequently used connections accessible, and leave enough slack to maintain the desk.
overlay_subhead: Cable management you can actually maintain.

title: Do This Before Buying a Cable Management Kit
description: Before buying trays, sleeves, clips, or raceways, remove dead cables, move the power strip, group stable runs, and give frequently used cables their own accessible path.

title: Cheap Desk Upgrades That Fix Real Problems
description: The best inexpensive desk upgrades reduce friction: better cable access, cleaner lighting, easier charging, less clutter, and more usable surface area.
overlay_subhead: Fix friction before buying more gear.

title: 5 Low-Cost Ways to Improve a Gaming Desk
description: You do not need a full rebuild to make a setup better. Start with low-cost changes that improve layout, lighting, cable access, storage, and daily usability.

title: Dark Gaming Setup Without RGB Overload
description: Midnight Shift is a dark gaming and work setup built around usable desk space, low clutter, controlled violet lighting, and gear that earns its footprint.

title: A Dark Gaming + Work Desk for Small Rooms
description: A gaming desk can still work for school or work. Midnight Shift protects the center desk area, keeps lighting controlled, and treats cable routing as part of the layout.
